assay: bulk RNA-seq of F4/80+ MACS-isolated Kupffer cells, Illumina NextSeq 550; Trimmomatic -> STAR (mm10) read counts (S2.15.p1)
sample_inclusion: male C57BL/6, 8-10 wk, randomised to 4 wk treadmill ExT or SED (S2.1.p1)
KCs from SED-control, EXT-control, SED-cancer-exosome and EXT-cancer-exosome mice, n = 3 per group (S2.15.p1)
sample_exclusion: FIG4A legend: SED-control n = 2 in the ExT-control vs SED-control volcano; which sample was dropped, and why, is not reported

factors.name: exo
factors.type: between-animal: in vivo cancer-exosome pre-education vs control (S2.4, S3.4.p1)

primary_estimand: Effect of 4-week treadmill exercise training on the Kupffer-cell transcriptome, (A) at baseline (ExT-control vs SED-control) and (B) under cancer-exosome education (ExT-exosome vs SED-exosome) (FIG4A-B, S3.4.p1). Secondary: exosome effect within SED (Fig. S5E, S3.4.p1).

planned_contrasts.name: C_SEDexo_vs_SEDctrl
planned_contrasts.definition: SED-exosome vs SED-control (IPA TREM-1 up; GSEA inflammatory)

blocking_or_covariance.status: not_required: one KC sample per mouse, independent groups

matrix_scale: STAR gene read counts (S2.15.p1; GEO data_processing)
paper_method: R/Bioconductor DESeq2 (S2.15.p1); model formula and whether pairwise or joint not reported

reported_counts.A_ExTctrl_vs_SEDctrl: not_reported (volcano FIG4A only, no count in text)

enrichment.GSEA: GSEA Java v4.3.2, h.all.v2023.2.Hs, mouse->human ortholog chip, 1000 permutations, FDR q < 0.25 (S2.15.p2)
enrichment.reported: inflammatory pathways (TNFa via NFkB, inflammatory response) up with exosome in SED, reversed by ExT; ExT reverses bile acid / xenobiotic / fatty acid metabolism / cholesterol homeostasis dysregulation (S3.4.p1, S4.p6)
